goal: Update the Tauri v2 client baseline and produce fresh Android and macOS client packages.
assumptions: Conservative Tauri client refresh only; no broad frontend dependency major migration.
APK is the first Android deliverable; AAB is built after APK succeeds.
macOS deliverable is the standard Tauri build output.
Version remains 0.1.0 unless the human requests a release version bump.
Existing local Android signing defaults are acceptable for QA installable builds only.
risks: Android packaging is blocked until Android SDK components are installed or configured.
Local branch is behind one upstream commit.
Tauri 2.11.0 refresh updates a sizable Rust transitive dependency graph.
Default local Android keystore is not production distribution signing.
macOS install script uses rm -rf and /Applications and must not run without explicit approval.
dependencies: Rust stable with rustfmt and clippy
Android SDK platform-tools, build-tools, platforms, cmdline-tools, and NDK
Network access to npm and crates.io
execution_gate: Wait for human approval of this plan before changing dependencies, installing SDK components, building packages, committing, pushing, or opening a PR.
